name: io.github.Servosity/threatdown-mcp
title: ThreatDown MCP
description: Every ThreatDown OneView API, plus fleet-wide stale-endpoint, health and seat reports across all

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the THREATDOWN_CLIENT_ID credential for the ThreatDown MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the THREATDOWN_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the ThreatDown MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: space-separated OAuth scopes to request; default `execute read write`.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the OneView API base URL (default https://api.threatdown.com/oneview).

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the OAuth2 token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends on OneView requests.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 to run the MCP server read-only.

environmentVariables.name: THREATDOWN_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by the stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit which sites a call can reach.
